other_conditions: The worker must be registered with the labour department.
The beneficiary must not have received assistance for last rites from any other department.
benefits_summary: A lump‑sum financial assistance of ₹6,000 is provided to the family of a deceased registered construction worker to cover funeral expenses.
documents_required: Photocopy of the first page of the applicant's bank passbook
Verification by the management of the institution/establishment at the designated place on the application form
